shellCommands.command: ls -la && git log --stat | head -30 && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; head -c 600 package-lock.json; node --version

cd /tmp && rm -rf smoke && mkdir smoke && cd smoke
BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/smoke/books.json PORT=3456 node /workspace/server.js & PID=$!; sleep 0.5
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "add: %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" -d 'title=The Hobbit&author=J. R. R. Tolkien&notes=Re-read.%0ALoving it.' localhost:3456/books
ID=$(node -e "console.log(require('/tmp/smoke/books.json')[0].id)")
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "finish: %{http_code}\n" -d "next=/books/$ID" localhost:3456/books/$ID/finish
kill $PID; wait $PID 2>/dev/null
BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/smoke/books.json PORT=3456 node /workspace/server.js & PID=$!; sleep 0.5
curl -s localhost:3456/books/$ID | sed -n '/<main>/,/<\/main>/p'
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "css: %{http_code}\n" localhost:3456/style.css
kill $PID; cat /tmp/smoke/books.json
